data.summary: Built and tested improved view-count classifier with 8 bigram phrase additions across NEED_INDICATORS and GENERIC_TERMS. Key quantitative results on E113 raw_pool.json (700 GitHub repos): labelled fraction improved from 28.8% to 32.2% (+3.4 pp, +11.7% relative). G1 population gate flipped from FAIL (need=104, generic=92) to PASS (need=109, generic=110). G0 discrimination preserved (10/10 planted need and generic recovered). Five new need phrases: 'prompt engineering', 'diffusion models', 'large language models', 'safety-critical', 'data pipeline'. Three new generic phrases: 'toolkit', 'platform', 'web application'. Improvement is engineering (vocabulary addition), not research. D083 domain sweep remains stopped per prior decision. View-count principle boundaries documented across 7+ domains. Single most useful next action: run improved classifier on other experiment raw pools to test whether coverage improvement generalizes beyond GitHub repos.)
